section.title: Code Lens

observation.p:
Known accessibility issues:
Tables used in rendering memory have no headers.
Small default text in memory tables, but can be enlarged with browser zoom.
Missing label on program output area and question input.
Links in visualizer not handled by screen readers.
Breakpoints not announced by screen readers.
No aria-live announcements of program output or state changes.
Execution slider is not keyboard controllable.
The CodeLens front end was developed by a third party. Addressing issues for it will require convincing them to make updates or replacing that with a new renderer.
